caption: Sorting Network Example.
subject: a worked trace of four numbers (9,6,4,8) through a 5-comparator sorting network producing sorted outputs 4,6,8,9

files.source.svg: author source SVG (from the paper's arXiv/source bundle)
files.preview.png: PNG render of the author SVG
files.semantics.json: full semantic record for this figure

groups.why_chosen: A concrete 4-element sorting network is traced end to end: each comparator sends the smaller input to the upper wire and the larger to the lower wire, and with inputs 9,6,4,8 colour-coded throughout, five comparators leave the wires sorted as 4,6,8,9.
groups.what_to_learn: One colour per tracked value, held across every wire; a separate miniature legend defining the one non-obvious symbol
